what: PulteGroup is one of the largest American homebuilders. It builds under Centex for first-time buyers, Pulte for move-up buyers and Del Webb for retirement communities, and also runs a mortgage and title business.
customers: First-time, move-up and retirement home buyers across major US markets.
money: homes sold across its three main brands
mortgage origination and title insurance for its own buyers
moat: Serving three distinct buyer groups from one operation, which lets it shift production toward whichever segment is strongest, plus land controlled through options rather than owned.
risks: High mortgage rates have slowed sales and forced price incentives
Buying down buyers' mortgage rates reduces gross margin
opportunities: Net margin of 13% is among the best in homebuilding
Del Webb retirement communities serve buyers less sensitive to mortgage rates
Debt of about $1.9 billion against $1.4 billion of cash is conservative for the industry
watch: Net new orders and gross margin after incentives.
